top_signals.title: Bank Indonesia Says 2027 Focus to Be on Stability, Inflation
top_signals.summary: Bank Indonesia will stay focused on stability next year as it pursues monetary policy that keeps inflation within its target range, while confronting sustained pressure on the rupiah.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
